description: Look at the construct with two manager panes
expected: xp is the pane ahead, tiling a pane to the right (black, empty), labels XP and TILING

description: Glide the camera in front of the xp pane
expected: The xp desktop shows large in the middle of the view

description: Move to the Start button in the xp pane and click
expected: The Start menu opens inside the pane
A terminal window opens inside the xp pane

description: Type 'echo hello from xp' and press Return
expected: The text appears in the xp terminal and the shell answers hello from xp

description: Glide the camera to the tiling pane
expected: The tiling pane (black) fills the middle of the view
The pane takes the keyboard (its edge lights up)

description: Press Super+Return in the tiling pane
expected: tiling opens a terminal that fills its pane

description: Type 'echo hello from tiling' and press Return
expected: The text appears in the tiling terminal and the shell answers

description: Glide back to the start pose
expected: Both panes in view again, both with a terminal
